title: Supervisor - Reconciliations
description:
**About Citco**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.
  
  
**About The Team & Business Line**
Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Your Role:**

* Supervise a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts supporting them and your Manager in servicing your clients.
* Ensure the team is able to work effectively, troubleshooting technical issues and working with the Manager to ensure that people are well matched to their work.
* Work with your team and with clients to ensure that risk on positions and activity is captured, with exposures supported or escalated.
* Monitor and manage regular break resolution, ensuring consistent timeliness and accuracy. Ensure that best practice protocols are consistently applied.
* Be a subject matter expert on Reconciliation processes and systems; well versed in financial instruments and the economics of maintaining positions (both theoretical and practical application in Aexeo).

* Coach and develop staff to perform successfully in their current roles and develop them into leadership positions.

* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* 4+ years in Financial Services.
* Product knowledge, Domestic, Global and OTC security markets, Fixed Income and derivative product knowledge.
* Advanced skills in MS Excel.
* Strong customer relationship management.
* Strong analytical skills.
* Experience supervising/coaching staff.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Knowledge of Hedge or Mutual Funds.
* Professional accounting designation is an asset.

**Core Skills And Behaviors You’ll Bring**
**Building Future Readiness**
– Demonstrates resilience by adapting well to change and is committed to improving knowledge and skills for the future.
  
  
**Delivering Client Excellence**
– Partners with internal and external clients to understand needs, develop solutions and deliver an excellent client experience.
  
  
**Problem Solving & Decision Making**
– Demonstrates Data Literacy to analyze issues, identify practical solutions, and make informed decisions while taking responsibility for outcomes.
  
  
**Building Relationships**
– Builds trusted relationships in an inclusive way. Positively influences outcomes while strengthening working relationships.
  
  
**Emotional Intelligence**
– Demonstrates self-awareness in identifying emotions, understanding triggers, and choosing appropriate behavior for the circumstance. Recognizes when biases may be impacting decisions. Seeks to understand and empathizes with others’ emotions and perspectives.

– Commits to protecting Citco by being aware of internal and external risks, thinking ahead to understand how those risks could affect people, processes or outcomes. Takes proactive steps using sound judgement to support safe and effective decision making. Values and promotes a strong risk culture.
  
  
**AI & Digital Literacy**
– Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-powered tools and evolving digital technologies to enhance productivity, efficiency, and quality of work
  
  
**Leadership Skills And Behaviors You’ll Bring**
**Strategic Thinking**
– Develops forward-looking strategies for growth by identifying market trends and transformation opportunities. Drives innovation by challenging conventions, fostering creativity, and translating insights into impactful strategies that position Citco for sustainable success.
  
  
**Distributing Leadership**
– Lets go of control and decision-making power to create space and opportunity for others to take on responsibility. Selects the right people and creates a supportive environment for leadership growth. Creates a culture where influence is valued over authority, with a strong emphasis on diverse experience.

– Shapes exceptional people experiences through empathetic leadership, creating a culture where people feel valued by building a people first, high performing culture through coaching, care and development – enabling individual success and driving business growth.

description:
**Overview**
As a
**Team Lead**
at RealPage, you will assess lender performance, ensure regulatory compliance, and manage financial risk. This role requires a solid background in underwriting US mortgages, knowledge of borrowers’ income and assets, and experience in reviewing escrow or condo documents.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Project Review and Analysis:**

* Follows and complies with current Agency and Investor project guidelines to ensure standards are met for mortgages sold and delivered, secured by units within Condominium Projects for various investors; Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA, and various Jumbo investors, as well as Co-op Projects for Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

* Analyze and approve condominium projects per loan program parameters, such as Limited Review, Full Review of Established, New Construction for conventional, FHA, and VA reviews.
* Communicates with the client for any decline or ineligible projects.

**Compliance And Guidelines**

* Stay current with relevant guidelines, updates, and industry best practices.
* Ensure all project reviews adhere to current standards and regulatory requirements.

**Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Lender Review Analysts to achieve performance targets and quality standards
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and identify training needs.
* Ensure workflow management, task allocation, and SLA adherence across the team.

**Qualifications**
**Desired Skills:**

* Demonstrate advanced product knowledge of Condominium project standards for FHA, both SUA and Delrap, Conventional, and other loan programs, such as Jumbo investors.
* Attention to detail, highly organized, and can meet SLA’s set by the company.
* Advanced ability to analyze complex condominium project documents such as CC&Rs, public offering, reserve studies, condominium insurance, and condominium plans.
* Ability to maintain an elevated level of professionalism, customer service, and communication with all parties involved in the loan cycle.
* Proficient with Encompass or other paperless mortgage loan origination systems.

****Required Qualifications:****

* 5+ years of relevant experience in risk management, US Mortgage, or Underwriting. At least 2+ years in a leadership or supervisory role.
* Background in underwriting US mortgages with knowledge of borrowers’ income, assets, and appraisal.
* Bachelor’s degree, Real Estate, Finance, or related field.

****Skills & Competencies:****

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills.
* High level of integrity and ethical standards.

* Drive robust documentation and knowledge management practices.

* Ensure effective transfer of process knowledge, process characterization data, and control strategies.
* Assess technical risks associated with process transfers and scale-up activities.

**Validation Activities**

* Support PPQ planning, execution, review and closure.
* Support process characterization and validation strategy development.
* Provide technical oversight for validation exceptions and deviations.
* Support ongoing process validation activities throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with Validation, Quality and Manufacturing organizations to maintain validated state.
* Review and approve validation protocols, reports, and technical documentation.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive initiatives to improve yield, throughput, process capability, and cost efficiency.
* Promote application of advanced analytics, PAT, digital tools, and data-driven process monitoring.
* Identify and implement innovative manufacturing solutions.

**People Leadership**

* Lead and develop Technical Managers and scientists within the upstream MS&T organization.
* Build technical capabilities and ensure succession planning.
* Foster a culture of scientific excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Key Performance Indicators**
**Quality & Compliance**

* Critical/Major inspection observations
* Recurring deviation rate
* Overdue deviations and CAPAs
* Upstream processes maintained in validated state

**Operational Excellence**

* Right First Time (RFT) manufacturing
* Upstream process yield achievement
* Upstream process CpK/PpK performance
* Process robustness indicators

**Delivery**

* Technology transfers delivered OTIF
* Validation/CPV milestones achieved
* Technical investigations completed on time

**Continuous Improvement**

* Yield/productivity improvement realization
* Successful implementation of process improvements

**People**

* Employee engagement
* Talent development and succession readiness
* Training compliance

**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**

* PhD in Biotechnology, Bioprocess Engineering, or related field (Preferred) / MSc in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Life Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline.
* 10 years experience in Biologics MS&T, Process Development, Technical Operations, or Manufacturing, 3-5 years leadership experience
* Strong expertise in upstream processing and commercial biologics manufacturing
* Experience in technology transfer and process validation
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections.
* Continuous manufacturing experience
* Multi-product commercial manufacturing support
* Advanced process analytics/PAT experience

title: Assistant Manager, Operations
description:
**Overview**
The
**Municipal Lien Manager**
plays a pivotal role in ensuring smooth real estate transactions by overseeing the complex processes related to municipal liens, property taxes, permits, code violations, and utilities across the US. This role requires an in-depth understanding of local government regulations and administrative structures, enabling seamless property sales and compliance with various legal requirements. As the leader of a dedicated team, you will be responsible for guiding the management of property liens, resolving lien-related issues, and ensuring accurate data retrieval from government websites. MLS Manager’s expertise will drive the efficiency of operations, support the professional growth of your team, and contribute to Rexera’s mission of transforming the real estate landscape through innovation and streamlined processes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Expertise in US Administrative Structures: Lead the team in understanding administrative frameworks across counties, cities, municipalities, towns, and townships in the US.
* Property Tax and Lien Mastery: Oversee the calculation and collection of property taxes, including assessment methods, payment procedures, and lien processes.
* Lien Management: Ensure proficient handling of property liens, including obtaining lien payoffs, clearing liens, and mitigating their impact on property sales.
* Government Website Navigation: Guide the team in effectively navigating government portals to retrieve crucial information on permits, code enforcement, utilities, and property taxes.
* Stay Updated on Regulations: Monitor changes in website layouts and content to maintain accuracy and efficiency in information retrieval.
* Code Violations & Permits: Manage code violations, understand their effect on property ownership, and implement strategies for resolution. Oversee the distinction between open and expired permits.
* Utility Management: Oversee the understanding of utility services in US homes and the billing processes for both public and private utility providers.
* Team Leadership: Provide guidance, mentoring, and management to the team, ensuring effective execution of tasks and continuous professional development.

**Qualifications**
**Essential Skills**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills with fluent English and an accent that is easily understood by American clients.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively with government officials, property owners, and stakeholders to resolve lien-related matters.
* Proficiency in using online research tools and computer software for data collection and management.
* Exceptional organizational skills with strong problem-solving abilities.
* Detail-oriented with the capability to manage multiple tasks and projects concurrently.

**Desired Skills**

* Prior experience managing municipal lien projects or working with US property liens and local government entities.
* Knowledge of permit search, code & real estate transactions, particularly as they relate to liens and tax procedures, is a strong advantage.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Public Administration, Real Estate, Finance, or a related field.
* A minimum of 8 years of overall experience, including at least 1 year leading a municipal lien team of 5 or more members.

description:
**Position Purpose**
The Associate Director, FinOps is accountable for establishing, scaling, and leading the enterprise FinOps practice across both cloud and on-premises technology estates, embedding financial accountability, cost transparency, and value optimization into how technology is consumed, designed, and governed. Acting as the senior bridge between Finance, Platform, and Application teams, the role drives cost visibility through show back and chargeback, owns spend governance, unlocks savings through commitment and optimization strategies, defines cost-aware design guidelines, and partners closely with cloud and infrastructure vendors to bring new cost-saving strategies, stronger governance, and improved cost visibility — while cultivating a durable culture of cost awareness and accountability across the organization.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Your responsibilities include, but not limited to**

* Cost Visibility, Reporting & Transparency: Build and own enterprise cost visibility across cloud and on-premises estates, delivering accurate, timely, and decision-ready reporting to Finance, Platform, and Application teams. Design and operate show back models and define chargeback frameworks that fairly and transparently allocate technology cost to business units, products, and services. Establish FinOps KPIs, dashboards, and unit-economics metrics that connect technology spend to business value and consumption.
* Spend Governance & Financial Accountability: Define, implement, and enforce spend governance policies, budgets, thresholds, tagging standards, and approval guardrails across the technology estate. Lead budgeting, forecasting, and variance management, proactively identifying cost anomalies, drift, and untagged or unaccountable spend. Drive financial accountability by ensuring every cost has a clear owner, allocation, and justification.
* Savings Enablement & Commitment Management: Enable savings through commitment-based approaches such as reserved instances, savings plans, committed-use discounts, and enterprise agreements, balancing flexibility against discount depth. Build and manage the commitment portfolio end to end, optimizing coverage, utilization, and renewal strategy to maximize realized savings. Structure rate, discount, and commercial savings strategies in partnership with vendors and procurement.
* Optimization & Efficiency: Run continuous optimization across cloud and on-premises — rightsizing, waste elimination, idle-resource reclamation, storage tiering, and utilization improvement. Establish optimization backlogs, savings targets, and realization tracking, holding platform and application teams accountable for execution. Quantify, validate, and report realized versus potential savings to leadership with clear evidence and trends.
* Cost-Aware Design Guidelines & Architecture: Create cost-aware design guidelines, reference patterns, and architectural standards that embed efficiency from the point of design. Partner with architecture and platform teams to make cost a first-class design constraint alongside performance, resilience, and security. Review major designs and changes for cost impact before they are built, preventing avoidable spend at the source.
* On-Premises FinOps & Lifecycle Management: Extend FinOps discipline beyond cloud to the on-premises estate, covering data centers, compute, storage, networking, and software licensing. Manage infrastructure and asset lifecycle — capacity planning, refresh cycles, depreciation, decommissioning, and total cost of ownership. Drive consistent cost visibility, allocation, and governance across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
* Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the trusted FinOps partner to Finance, Platform teams, and Application teams, translating fluently between financial and technical perspectives. Align stakeholders around shared cost objectives, allocation models, and accountability frameworks. Influence and drive adoption of FinOps practices across decentralized engineering and business teams.
* Vendor & Partner Cost Strategy: Work closely with cloud and infrastructure vendors to bring new cost-saving strategies, pricing constructs, and emerging capabilities to the organization. Partner with vendors to improve governance, strengthen cost visibility, and unlock commercial and technical efficiency. Benchmark vendor commercial models and leverage strategic relationships to continuously improve value.
* Cost Awareness & FinOps Culture: Build and embed a culture of cost awareness and accountability across technology and business teams. Deliver enablement, training, and communication that turn engineers and stakeholders into cost-conscious decisionmakers. Champion the FinOps operating model, maturing its capabilities, processes, and tooling over time.

**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**

* 10–12+ years of experience in FinOps, IT financial management, technology cost optimization, or cloud and infrastructure financial governance, including time in a senior or lead capacity.
* FinOps Practice Leadership: Proven track record establishing, scaling, or leading an enterprise FinOps practice across both cloud and on-premises environments.
* Cloud & On-Premises Cost Management: Deep, hands-on understanding of cost management across hyperscale cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises data center, licensing, and infrastructure lifecycle economics.
* Commitment & Savings Strategy: Demonstrated expertise in commitment-based savings (reserved instances, savings plans, committed-use discounts), rate optimization, and realized-savings management.
* Governance, Reporting & Financial Acumen: Strong command of show back and chargeback, budgeting, forecasting, unit economics, and spend governance, with the ability to connect cost to business value.
* Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Advanced ability to partner across Finance, Platform, and Application teams and to work with cloud and infrastructure vendors to drive new cost and governance strategies.
* Influence & Cost Culture: Proven ability to build cost awareness and accountability, driving change through influence across decentralized technical and business teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related discipline; master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MSc in Finance or Technology Management) strongly preferred.
* FinOps Certified Practitioner or Professional, cloud cost or cloud architecture certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP), IT asset management / ITIL certifications are a plus.
